conclusion.strongest_RH_iff_GRH_results: Conditional on an explicit generalized Cayley lift or cross-family transfer.
conclusion.RH_to_GRH_frontier: The lift, cross-family transfer, primitive-character zero-freeness, centered/reflection-pair nonvanishing, and completed-L four-factor nonvanishing are equivalent formulations of RH → Dirichlet GRH. None is proved as an unconditional proposition in these sources. The new universal first completed-L-factor nonvanishing condition is source-reduced to the four-factor condition by inversion and primitive zero reflection; that universal condition remains OPEN, with native verification NOT_RUN.
conclusion.GRH_scope: Zeros of actual Mathlib DirichletCharacter.LFunction in 0 < Re(s) < 1, first primitive characters, then all characters via the primitive-character Euler-factor bridge. Not a theorem for arbitrary automorphic/Artin L-functions.
conclusion.finite_witness: None. The analytic criteria quantify over all moduli, appropriate characters, and critical-domain points or admissible real sample pairs.

main_definitions.name: RHToGRHCompletedLFactor.RiemannToPrimitiveCharacterCompletedLFactorsNonzero
main_definitions.formula: RH → for every nonzero modulus N, primitive χ, and z in the critical square domain and Complex.slitPlane, Λ(χ, 1/2+sqrt z), Λ(χ⁻¹, 1/2+sqrt z), Λ(χ, 1-(1/2+sqrt z)), and Λ(χ⁻¹, 1-(1/2+sqrt z)) are nonzero.

main_definitions.name: RHToGRHFirstFactor.RiemannToPrimitiveCharacterFirstCompletedLFactorNonzero
main_definitions.formula: _root_.RiemannHypothesis → ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N), χ.IsPrimitive → ∀ z ∈ CayleyGRHStrong.completedPairCriticalSquareDomain, z ∈ Complex.slitPlane → DirichletCharacter.completedLFunction χ (1 / 2 + z.sqrt) ≠ 0

source_audit.excluded_from_code_scan: Nested Lean comments, line comments, string literals
source_audit.limitations: This lexical scan does not determine elaborated kernel dependencies or imported Mathlib axioms. Only a native #print axioms result can do that.

caveats: Names such as A_TIER or comments saying already-compiled are historical source language, not a current verification claim.
Existing RH_IFF_GRH_OF_GENERALIZED_CAYLEY_LIFT and RH_IFF_GRH_OF_CROSS_CAYLEY_TRANSFER must never be presented with their hLift/hTransfer parameters omitted.
COMPLETED_L_FACTORS_NONZERO_IFF_RH_IMPLIES_GRH proves an equivalence involving the implication RH → GRH; it proves neither that implication nor the left-hand analytic frontier.
GeneralizedCharacter.lean is scalar geometric-sequence algebra, not a construction of Dirichlet characters or a GRH proof.

The actual logarithmic-derivative observable is Option-valued with none exactly at a denominator zero; totality does not by itself establish a separate global holomorphy theorem for the principal character.

RHToGRHCenteredPairFrontier.lean:57–66 uses hRH without a visible local binder in CENTERED_COMPLETED_PAIR_GLOBAL_IFF_POINTWISE. Independent source review expects an unintended outer implicit {hRH : RiemannHypothesis} under the default automatic-implicit settings, or an unknown-identifier failure with those settings disabled. No native printed signature was found. The prepared #check @ exposes this at native validation. This helper is not used by the main RH↔GRH lift, cross-transfer, or four-factor endpoints; original bytes remain unchanged.

FIRST_FACTOR_IFF_RH_IMPLIES_GRH reduces the same universal open implication to one completed-L factor family. It does not prove that family, a finite witness criterion, RH → GRH, or unconditional RH ↔ GRH; native compilation and axiom auditing remain NOT_RUN.
